events.label: Наука
entries: 1859 – Petroleum is discovered in Titusville, Pennsylvania, leading to the world's first commercially successful oil well.

1956 – The nuclear power station at Calder Hall in the United Kingdom was connected to the national power grid becoming the world's first commercial nuclear power station to generate electricity on an industrial scale.
1962 – The Mariner 2 unmanned space mission is launched to Venus by NASA.
1985 – Space Shuttle Discovery is launched on STS-51-I to deploy three communication satellites and repair a fourth malfunctioning one.

2003 – The first six-party talks, involving South and North Korea, the United States, China, Japan and Russia, convene to find a peaceful resolution to the security concerns of the North Korean nuclear weapons program.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1943 – World War II: Japanese forces evacuate New Georgia Island in the Pacific Theater of Operations during World War II.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1955 – The first edition of the Guinness Book of Records is published in Great Britain.
